artworks.title: Jason with the Golden Fleece
artworks.description: Thorvaldsen's neoclassical Jason — the son Alcimede bears to Aeson in Apollonius and Hyginus, the Minyan mother behind the Argonaut captain.

artworks.title: Medea Rejuvenates Aeson
artworks.description: Guidobono's Medea restoring Aeson — Alcimede's husband and Jason's father in the Argonaut genealogy that ties Iolcus to the Minyan line.

popCulture.title: Alcimede (mother of Jason)
popCulture.description: Daughter of Phylacus and Clymene, wife of Aeson, mother of Jason — not every minor Alcimede of the catalogues.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: Alcimede's son — the Argonaut leader her Minyan blood legitimates in Apollonius' opening genealogy.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius names Alcimede among Jason's kin at the launch from Iolcus — the mother who weeps as the Argo sails.

popCulture.title: Aeson
popCulture.description: Alcimede's husband — Pelias' brother and the rightful king whose son she raises for the fleece-quest.
